title: Race of laughs
text: It was a very well organised adventure throughout the city. My team had a blast and I would recommend it to any group passing by Barcelona.
author: D6203IVvictord

title: Hen party treasure hunting fun
text: Cannot recommend enough - extremely well organised with great clues and treasure hunting. You get to see the city at the same time and the guides give you the history along the way. We had a fabulous time as a group celebrating a hen party.
author: Charliebn

title: The best time!
text: We did The Explorer Hunt in Barcelona as a group of 8 from the UK on a Hen party, and organised this as a surprise for the bride. I have to say, the hunt exceeded our expectations! Gonzalo was our guide and was great - very informative, relaxed and helped us when we needed prompting! The puzzles were unique and beautifully made, and brought out lots of different skills in each of us. This activity combined the fun intrigue of escape room type puzzles, with history, team-building, and a tour of beautiful Barcelona - the bride absolutely loved it! title: Great team building activity!
text: We did a scavenger hunt with Xventura as a teambuilding activity with our company and had so much fun! The difficulty of the challenges was perfect: not too easy but also not imposible to solve. We had to work together, communicate and use all our skills to be able to fulfill the assignments. I really liked the puzzles and the material that was used, also the guides were very professional and nice! And the fact that it's played totally offline is just awesome.
